prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car wreck — the right lawyer depends on the details of your case (injuries, fault, insurance limits, whether you need a trial, etc.) and on what you value (trial experience, communication, record of big verdicts/settlements). I can help you find the best fit. A few quick options:

If you want me to recommend names, tell me:
- Your ZIP code or neighborhood in Houston
- How serious the injuries are (minor, moderate, severe / permanent)
- Whether the at-fault driver had insurance (and limits)
- Any upcoming deadlines (suit deadline, hearings)

If you want to search yourself, use these practical criteria and resources.

What to look for in a top Houston car-crash lawyer
- Focus: handles car-accident/personal-injury cases primarily (not general practice).
- Experience & trial skills: plenty of jury trial experience and recorded verdicts/settlements.
- Track record with similar injury types and insurance situations.
- Reputation: peer reviews (Martindale-Hubbell), Super Lawyers listings, client reviews.
- Communication: clear answer about who will handle the case day to day and how often they’ll update you.
- Fees: contingency basis with a written contract; know the percentage and who pays court costs, experts, etc.
- Resources: can hire accident reconstructionists, medical experts, life-care planners when needed.

Red flags
- Guarantees of a certain result or dollar amount.
- Pressure to sign immediately.
- No written fee agreement or unwillingness to explain fees.
- Poor communication in initial contact.

Questions to ask in a free consultation
- Have you handled cases like mine? What was the outcome?
- Do you try cases or mostly settle?
- Who will handle the file—partner, associate, paralegal?
- What’s your contingency fee and when are costs deducted?
- Estimated timeline and likely value range and why.
- Can you provide references from past clients?

Where to find reputable Houston lawyers
- Texas Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service
- Super Lawyers (Houston listings)
- Martindale-Hubbell peer reviews
- Google and Yelp reviews (read multiple reviews)
- Local trial lawyer associations (e.g., Houston Trial Lawyers Association)

Immediate steps after a wreck (if you haven’t already)
- Get medical care and follow doctor’s orders.
- Preserve evidence: photos, medical records, police report, witness contacts.
- Don’t give recorded statements to insurers without a lawyer.
- Note deadlines for filing suit (statute of limitations in Texas is generally two years from the date of injury).

If you’d like, tell me the ZIP code and a couple details about your case and I’ll pull together 3–5 Houston attorneys/firms with strong reputations and explain why they might fit your situation.
